relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP inhibited the expression of P2RX7, thus inhibited neuronal death, resulting in downregulation of epileptic seizures.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP alleviated epilepsy in mice, characterized by a reduction in the frequency and grade of epileptic seizures

relationships.subject: JAK1-STAT1 pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: JAK1-STAT1 pathway was identified as a pivotal pathway that can be engaged by CGRP to inhibit P2RX7 in epilepsy

key_findings: CGRP alleviates kainic acid-induced epilepsy in mice, reducing seizures, inflammation and neuronal damage.
CGRP suppresses P2RX7 expression via the JAK1-STAT1 pathway.
